description:
Property Reference: 2984183.

The Property
Beautiful 2 double bedroom garden apartment in the heart of Clifton Down.

 The apartment is finished to a exceptional standard throughout. With new carpets, bathroom, kitchen and windows this is a high end luxury apartment with coveted outdoor private space. 

Lounge
This beautiful garden apartment boasts a spacious reception room with large double glazed patio doors that flood the room with natural light and exit to a private paved garden. The room is tastefully decorated and available unfurnished with ample space for comfortable seating and a dining table, making it the perfect space for entertaining guests or relaxing after a long day. The patio doors lead to a large south facing private garden area.
Kitchen
The modern kitchen is equipped with induction hob, fan assisted oven and grill with catalytic liners for easy cleaning and extractor fan to the outside. Stainless steel Franke sink and drainer and Grohe taps provide high end details to a stylish kitchen. The kitchen is pre-plumbed for a washer/dryer and dishwasher in addition to a fridge/freezer. There is ample worktops with storage for all your culinary ambitions, and matching easy clean splashbacks. A breakfast bar at the end of the kitchen provides the perfect start to the day. 

Bedrooms
There are two well-proportioned double bedrooms. The master bedroom is large, tastefully decorated  with double glazed sliding sash windows providing ample light for a garden flat. The second bedroom provide sufficient space for a double bed and wardrobes. Similarly double glazing sliding sash windows provide a light and airy atmosphere.

Bathroom
There is new family bathroom with a Mira rain shower over a fullsize bath. Walls are finished with bright white easy clean Mira flight wall panels. The remaining suite utilises Grohe taps and sanitary ware with heated and illuminated mirror. Electric, wifi controlled, towel radiators provide a luxury finish to the room. 

Hallway / additional storage
A large entrance hall way leads to all other rooms, there are two cupboards which provide useful additional storage.

Outdoor space
There is large south facing private patio, with ample space for outdoor living area, surrounded by a 6ft privacy fence. 

 Location
Perfectly positioned approximately Transport
Clifton Down train station (less than 100m away) provides regular access to Bristol Temple Meads throughout the day, serving the wider country including London, Devon and Cornwall. 

There are good communication links, the A4018 (Clifton Triangle) provides direct access to the commercial centre and motorway networks including M32, M4 and M5. Bristol Airport is approximately 8 miles away and offers flights to a number of European and some long haul destination.

Area: 743 sq ft /  69 sq m
